docs.summary: A camera's blended volume settings: one component per type, from the type's defaults, then the camera's base profile, then each volume it listens to, and the Graphite features those values drive. Features belong to the camera and are never shared. A component whose values turn it off keeps its feature for a short while ([`DeactivationFrames`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Rendering.VolumeStack~DeactivationFrames)), so a fade through zero does not rebuild the view each frame.
Resolves an effect stays on for after its values turned it off.
